description: Use ONLY for the normal repair flow after quote_repair has already returned a quoteId and the caller explicitly chooses that existing quote. This tool does not create a quote: with confirm=true it records acceptance of that quote and creates checkout instructions on exactly one rail offered by it. Do NOT use this tool for owner/platform-preauthorized autonomous purchasing where the agent is allowed to choose one of the four capped micro-services and create its own quote; use request_delegated_purchase for that separate flow. APPLE_PAY returns a human handoff URL for buyer authorization; BASE_USDC and TRON_USDT return payer transfer instructions. It never sends funds, charges the caller, verifies payment or directly starts repair execution. After the buyer completes the required payment action, use verify_repair with the returned checkoutId and the same rail.

confirm.description: Must be true to record explicit acceptance before checkout instructions are created.

quoteId.description: Exact quoteId returned by quote_repair and explicitly accepted by the caller.

rail.description: Choose exactly one rail offered in quote_repair.paymentRails. Saudi quotes normally offer APPLE_PAY only.

source.description: Optional attribution label for the calling agent or integration.

name: prepare_repair

outputSchema.description: Accepted quote plus checkout instructions. A successful result includes checkout information and nextTool=verify_repair; no funds are sent by this tool.

automaticExecution.description: False; this preparation step does not directly execute repair.

automaticJob.description: False; this preparation step does not start a repair job.

automaticPayment.description: False; no automatic charge or transfer occurs.

checkout.description: Checkout record/instructions returned for the selected rail; includes the checkout identifier used by verify_repair.

error.description: Present when quote acceptance or checkout preparation failed.

fundsSent.description: False; this tool does not send funds.

nextAction.description: For APPLE_PAY, human handoff information; for wallet rails, payer transfer instructions.

nextTool.description: verify_repair after the buyer completes the payment action.

paymentVerified.description: False until verify_repair confirms an existing payment.

quoteAcceptance.description: Commerce acknowledgement that the quote was accepted.

title: Prepare Repair
